sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The Greeks' spiritual war aimed to make Israel forget that the Torah is G-d's Torah and to nullify the G-dliness in the mitzvos, targeting specifically the chukim and the aspect of Divine will.

translations.translation: And the explanation of the matter in the service of man will be understood by prefacing what is explained in the discourses of my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe,
that the fact that the Greeks defiled the oils in the Heichal is because their entire war was a spiritual war,
they did not want to harm the bodies of Israel,
rather their main desire was to cause them to forget Your Torah and to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will.
And even within this itself,
(in that they fought against Torah and mitzvos),
their main war was against the spirituality
(and G-dliness)
of Torah and mitzvos.
For this is "to cause them to forget Your Torah"
(specifically Your Torah),
for the Greeks did not care
(so much)
that Israel should study Torah,
rather they wanted that the study of Torah be only from the aspect of the intellect within the Torah,
for it is "your wisdom and understanding in the eyes of the nations",
and their entire war was that they sought to cause them to forget Your Torah,
to cause Israel to forget, G-d forbid, that the Torah is the Torah of Havayah.
And similarly regarding mitzvos,
the war of the Greeks was against the G-dliness within the mitzvos,
that the mitzvos are His will, for this is "to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will"
(specifically statutes and specifically Your will),
and there are two explanations of this.
Regarding the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments,
since they are rational mitzvos,
the Greeks also agreed to them,
and their entire war was against the mitzvos of chukim,
since the manner of their fulfillment is only because they are the will of Havayah.
And a second explanation
(more deeply),
that this that they sought to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will applies to all mitzvos,
even to the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Even rational mitzvos must be fulfilled primarily because they are G-d's will, above human intellect, and the Greeks sought to uproot the awareness of this G-dly aspect in all mitzvos.

translations.translation: And this will be understood based on what is known,
that even the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments must be fulfilled
(primarily)
because they are the will of G-d,
like the chukim.
And this matter
(that even mitzvos for which there is a reason must be fulfilled because they are the will of G-d)
is not only from the perspective of the person fulfilling them,
that his fulfillment of mitzvos must be in the manner of the service of a servant,
which is specifically when he fulfills the mitzvos
(not because of the reason and intellect,
but rather)
because of the command of the Master,
but also from the perspective of the mitzvos themselves,
for all mitzvos
(even mitzvos for which there is a reason)
are His will,
a will that is above reason,
and only that the Holy One, blessed be He, decreed that the will of these mitzvos should also be clothed in reason.
Moreover,
even the reasons for the mitzvos
(as they are in their truth)
are above the comprehension of human intellect,
for the true reasons for the mitzvos are as they are in His wisdom,
and since His wisdom is also infinite
(and especially that He and His wisdom are one),
therefore it is impossible that the limited intellect of creatures can grasp the true reason of the mitzvos,
as it is written in Igeres HaKodesh
that the reasons for the mitzvos were not revealed and they are above intellect and understanding,
and also in "Eizehu Mekoman" where some reason that is understandable to us was revealed and explained,
behold, this reason that is understandable to us is not the ultimate reason, etc.
And this matter
(that the reason understandable to us is not the ultimate reason)
is also understood by human intellect.
For even human intellect understands simply,
that a limited intellect is incapable of grasping His unlimited wisdom.
And on the contrary,
this that in "Eizehu Mekoman" some reason understandable to us was revealed and explained is a great wonder,
and it is only a kindness of G-d that even the human intellect should have some comprehension of this.
And even after, through the kindness of G-d, a reason understandable to us was revealed and explained,
behold it is known
that the reason is only for the mitzvah in general and not for its details.
From all this it is understood,
that even the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments are
(like)
chukim relative to us
(since even the reasons for the mitzvos from the perspective of His wisdom are above the intellect of creatures),
and furthermore, they are "Your will"
(His will which is above even His wisdom).
And this is that what the Greeks sought, "to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will," applies also to the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments,
for the Greeks sought to uproot, G-d forbid, from Israel the G-dly feeling within the mitzvos,
that all mitzvos are His wisdom which is above human intellect
("to cause them to transgress the statutes"),
and they sought to uproot, G-d forbid, the feeling that the mitzvos are His will
("Your will").

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The Greeks entered the Heichal (Binah) and defiled all the oils (Chochmah) to ensure Torah study and mitzvah observance would be only from intellect, not from the aspect of G-dliness.

translations.translation: And with this the language of the Gemara will be understood: "When the Greeks entered the Heichal, they defiled all the oils that were in the Heichal,"
for the implication of the language is,
that when they entered the Heichal, they endeavored and exerted themselves to defile the oils
(in order to defeat Israel, G-d forbid),
for Heichal is Binah and oil is Chochmah, which is above the intellect of Binah
(as above in section 2, that oil is the aspect of holiness),
and therefore they defiled all the oils that were in the Heichal of Binah,
in order to achieve, G-d forbid, their evil design to cause them to forget Your Torah and to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will,
so that the study of Torah and fulfillment of mitzvos would be only from the aspect of intellect.
